title: Justice Mission 2025 Research Benchmark

coverage.description: Publicly reported exercise activity around Taiwan, including announced live fire areas, force measures, activity claims, and unresolved asset identities.

known_gaps: Exact public notices and geometries for the additional warning areas reported after the initial five zone announcement have not been recovered.
No complete public type breakdown exists for the 207 aircraft sorties.
No complete public roster of unique participating aircraft or ships exists.
The exact number of rocket launcher vehicles is unknown.
The identity of the Type 075 amphibious assault ship remains disputed in collected reporting.
Individually named PLAN and China Coast Guard hulls require source by source validation.
The 15 vessel Coast Guard exercise snapshot and 8 official ship daily reports use different reporting scopes.
The second day interim PLAN vessel count differs between secondary reconstructions.
The Baoji or Baoyi formation identity requires original language source review.
notes: Research benchmark only. Not an approved simulation starting state.
